quotes.text: First, we need commonsense permitting reform to cut red tape and get broadband and wireless projects off the ground faster. [...] Second, we should be harnessing the power of AI to speed up deployment and strengthen our cybersecurity.
Could Federal support for AI-based project review tools actually make the deployment process faster and more predictable?
Every parent I talk to is doing everything they can to guide their kids and protect them online, on social media, through gaming platforms, and now AI.
The SAFE Bots Act ensures no AI system can impersonate a licensed professional and requires age-appropriate disclosure so kids always know that they are talking to software, not a human being.
